Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically compares the extracellular protein composition of bioprinted models containing either cancer-associated fibroblasts (CAF) or normal mammary fibroblasts (NMF) at two different maturation timepoints (day 1 and day 7). While the study also explores radiotherapy and chemotherapy, the MS data described in the methods and PRIDE metadata are focused on the CAF vs NMF comparison.

MStype_prompt.notes: The experiment focuses on the extracellular matrix (matrisome) of a 3D bioprinted model. While it targets the extracellular fraction, it does not use specific PTM-enrichment antibodies (like phospho or ubiquitin) that would trigger a specific modifier workflow from the provided list. It is a standard bottom-up DDA LFQ run.
